insights: Dwelling Contractor Certification: Wisconsin requires certification for contractors on dwellings Wisconsin DSPS requires Dwelling Contractor Certification for one and two-family homes—verify at dsps.wi.gov. Specialty trades also need credentials.

Harsh Winter Construction: Wisconsin winters are severe—proper insulation and heating are critical Temperatures regularly drop below 0°F. Reddit emphasizes high R-value insulation, air sealing, and quality windows. Heating costs are substantial without proper efficiency.
Ice Dams & Roof Issues: Wisconsin Ice dams cause major interior damage. Reddit strongly recommends proper attic ventilation and insulation, plus ice/water shield extended well past eaves.

Radon Testing: Wisconsin has significant radon levels throughout the state Wisconsin DHS recommends testing all homes. Reddit strongly recommends testing before basement finishing. Mitigation is effective and typically costs $800-1500.
